rationale: Core implementation is correct: renderExpandedContent allFit branch wraps PinnedRow items in semantic ul/li with CSS resets and key on li. One major finding: Tailwind list-none (list-style:none) causes VoiceOver on Safari to strip the ARIA list role from the ul, negating the semantic accessibility benefit on that platform. Fix: add role="list" to the ul. Three deferred findings: collapsed-view parity (out of scope), no allFit=false overflow-path test (coverage gap), plan.md references wrong component (doc defect only).

business_review.criterion: FAQ/Chatbot items wrapped in ul > li in expanded view
business_review.notes: renderExpandedContent allFit path returns ul > li > PinnedRow. NavigationPinnedSection is the component that actually renders the FAQ/Chatbot items in the live render tree.

business_review.criterion: Test-first with 4 tests covering ul presence, li wrapping, no-ul-when-not-fetched
business_review.notes: 4 tests exist and cover all named criteria. Test-first ordering is consistent with TDD but not provable from diff alone. Plan outcome metric references wrong component (NavigationAssistants vs NavigationPinnedSection) and wrong test count (14 vs 4) — doc defect.

business_review.criterion: Gap spacing consistent with existing component
business_review.notes: gap-1.5 on ul matches outer wrapper gap-1.5. Plan specified gap-2; gap-1.5 is the correct consistent choice.

Plan artifact repeatedly names NavigationAssistants.tsx (dead code — never imported by any application component). Implementation correctly targets NavigationPinnedSection.tsx. Plan is a documentation defect; implementation is correct.

standards_review.notes: Key correctly placed on li element, no unused parameters, event handler signatures valid, TypeScript compiles (pre-commit hook verified).
list-style:none via Tailwind list-none removes ARIA list role in VoiceOver/Safari without an explicit role=list. The semantic list structure is present in markup but stripped by AT on that platform.

findings.problem: Tailwind list-none (list-style: none) causes VoiceOver on Safari to strip the ARIA list role from the ul element. The semantic list structure exists in markup but is invisible to screen readers on that platform.
findings.impact: VoiceOver/Safari users receive no list announcement or item count when navigating the FAQ/Chatbot section — the primary accessibility goal of the ul/li change is not achieved for them.
findings.recommendation: Add role="list" to the ul: <ul role="list" className="list-none p-0 m-0 flex flex-col gap-1.5">. This explicitly restores the list semantics that list-none strips in VoiceOver/Safari.
